description: Use when someone asks to write or draft an offer letter for a property. Takes a Dallas County or Collin County, Texas address (or a lead_id) and an offer price, with optional earnest money, inspection and closing days, expiry, buyer name and title company, and returns the text of a one-page, non-binding letter of intent addressed to the owner of record, plus a link to the property in RBSHome, where the PDF is made by re-entering the price and terms on the Offer tab. Nothing is sent or stored. Use analyze_deal first for a price. Counts as a property lookup. Read-only.

address.description: Street address in Dallas or Collin County, Texas, e.g. '1234 Elm St, Plano TX 75023'

assignable.description: Buyer may assign the contract (default true)

buyer_name.description: Buyer or company name for the signature block

expiry_days.description: Days the offer stays open, default 7

lead_id.description: RBSHome lead ID like 'Collin:2771234', when already known (skips the address lookup)

offer_price.description: Offer price in dollars, e.g. 72000 (analyze_deal gives an MAO)

title_company.description: Title company; default: one chosen by the buyer

name: draft_offer_letter
title: Draft an offer letter
